description: GUI default (Phase 128, 2026-11-04): the generic twin turboprop of Cabin_Noise's default project (cabin_noise/data/default_project.json), its values copied by hand; the two programs share no code or file. Propeller: Heart HP_1650 geometry at helical tip Mach 0.85 (see assumptions). Cruise, 7620 m ISA, Mach 0.4818, 6 blades, 1181 rpm, tip radius 1.7526 m, tip-to-fuselage clearance 1.1 m, cabin 22.7 m long and 2.64 m wide, skin 1.6 mm of density 2780, double wall: 0.09 m blanket cavity behind a 2.7 kg/m2 trim panel. Inputs Cabin_Noise does not have are stated in 'assumptions'. Not a validation case: no comparison with data.
assumptions: Radius a = cabin width / 2 = 1.32 m (Cabin_Noise models a box, PAIN a cylinder).
Hub distance r_p = a + tip radius + clearance = 4.1699 m; propeller plane at mid-cabin, z_p = L/2 = 11.35 m (Cabin_Noise has no station relative to the cabin).

Propeller geometry (2026-11-04): Heart HP_1650 from propeller_sizing_and_analysis/propellers/hp_1650 (propeller.yaml, blade_form.csv): 6 blades, D 3.49988 m (R 1.74994 m), hub = spinner radius 0.325 m, the 39 stations of blade_form.csv at r/R >= 0.1857 (the two inside the spinner are dropped), chord = c/R x R, twist = the file's beta_deg (chord-line datum, set at the file's first design point, beta75 34.281 deg; pitch offset 0). The tip radius replaces Cabin_Noise's 1.7526 m.

area_over_chord2: the file's t/c per station through naca4_area_over_chord2 (a NACA 4-digit thickness shape; the file's sections are NACA 16-series, whose area differs slightly). Clear the field for loading-only noise.

rpm 1183.33: set so the helical tip Mach number sqrt(V^2 + (Omega R)^2) / c = 0.85 at the flight speed and sound speed below (author 2026-11-04); Cabin_Noise's 1181 rpm is replaced. Shaft power (1.64 MW in Cabin_Noise) is not a PAIN input.
Outside air: ISA at 7620 m (T 238.62 K). Cabin air: the pressure of ISA 2438.4 m at 293.15 K, the formulas of Cabin_Noise's atmosphere.py.
ANOPP Table 8 scaling off: Table 8 is the 0.762 m Hartzell test, not this propeller.
Insulation table extrapolated (X-EXTRAP): the 22.7 m cabin has structural modes from about 13 Hz, below the 100 Hz start of the PF-105 table.
Harmonics: 5 (Cabin_Noise's auto takes every harmonic below 5 kHz).
